# Vendored: UUG.AI Hub widgets

React components that reproduce Kerberos Hub's UI, copied from UUG.AI's
design system so the dashboard matches Hub.

- Source: https://github.com/uug-ai/design, `src/components/HubWidgets`
- Commit: `65c6357152da6d6b14d0337954691bccf30be82b` (2026-11-06)
- License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

The library files are copied unmodified. Left out: the Storybook stories
(one `stories.tsx` per sub-folder) and the `examples.tsx` demo page, which
are documentation rather than components.

To update, copy the same files from a newer commit and update the hash above.
Do not edit these files in place; wrap or extend them from `src/` instead.
